title: EXCLUSIVE: Richard Harpin has given the Tories £375,000 since 2008 .

metadata.reference_highlights:
EXCLUSIVE: Richard Harpin has given the Tories £375,000 since 2008 .
Mr Harpin is the chief executive of maintenance firm HomeServe .
Company was fined a record £30million last year for mis-selling insurance .
Customers were misled or bullied into buying policies they did not need .
